entries.source: Go out the gate to Lakeside County and talk to [Trainer].
entries.text: 走出城門前往湖畔郡，與導師交談。
entries.reason: 固定來源的Trainer是導師占位；保留交談對象，不沿用刪除標記後缺少對象的英文。

entries.source: Hex Spell. You lose all Energy. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, target foe suffers [[MO:growth:0:var2]] Energy degeneration, and you experience [[MO:growth:0:var3]] Energy regeneration.
entries.text: 降咒魔法。你失去所有能量。持續 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒，目標敵人受到 [[MO:growth:0:var2]] 能量衰減，你獲得 [[MO:growth:0:var3]] 能量再生。
entries.reason: 對照固定正文與成長表；敵人的衰減綁var2，自身再生綁var3。符號由獨立效果呈現，不將兩項相同數字當成同一效果。

entries.source: Hex Spell. For [[MO:growth:0:var1]] seconds, target foe suffers [[MO:growth:0:var2]] Health degeneration, and you gain [[MO:growth:0:var3]] Health regeneration.
entries.text: 降咒魔法。持續 [[MO:growth:0:var1]] 秒，目標敵人受到 [[MO:growth:0:var2]] 體力衰減，你獲得 [[MO:growth:0:var3]] 體力再生。
entries.reason: 逐項核對持續時間、敵人的體力衰減與自身體力再生；var2和var3保持獨立，不因數值相同而共用身份。
